conditions: Shared host; CPU 0 affinity; SMT not isolated; buffered existing caches; no cache dropping, storage tuning, or concurrent agent builds/tests/plotting. Full native readback and filefrag between timed copies. All command attempts retained.

commands.copy: taskset -c 0 FROZEN_CLI copy PRIVATE_SOURCE PRIVATE_RAW --format vmdk --json --backend auto [--progress]
commands.readback: taskset -c 0 FROZEN_SPARSE_CLI verify PRIVATE_SOURCE PRIVATE_RAW --format vmdk --json
commands.metrics: /usr/bin/time wall,user,system,maxrss around the entire taskset command
